WITH state_totals AS (
    SELECT c.state_county_province, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS state_total
    FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft
    JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = ft.invoice_number
    JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
    JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.state_county_province
), state_shares AS (
    SELECT state_county_province,
           state_total,
           state_total / SUM(state_total) OVER () AS share
    FROM state_totals
), above_average AS (
    SELECT state_total, share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM state_shares
)
SELECT SUM(state_total) AS combined_transaction_total,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average
WHERE share > average_share

assumptions.assumption: A state total with no non-NULL transaction amounts is treated as NULL and therefore excluded from the shares; states with recorded amounts that sum to zero remain included. The schema does not specify a database engine, so the query uses window functions and assumes they are supported.
